delta_gap_trend.quantity: Absolute pKa gap versus leave-scaffold-out signed projection
delta_gap_trend.limit: Exploratory pair-level permutation; shared molecules and cross-fitted directions induce dependence not modelled by this test.

method.quantity: cos(theta) = d^T u / ||d||, with d oriented from lower to higher pKa
method.direction: mean of training unit pair displacements; independent of PkaHead gradients
method.primary_validation: leave-one-pair-out plus exclusion of all pairs sharing a Murcko scaffold with either test endpoint
method.data_limit: Only h_test and 43 G4 test pairs were available; this is cross-fitted test-pair evidence, not an independent train-pair-to-test-pair experiment.
method.interpretation_limit: A low global projection does not rule out learnable local or scaffold-specific geometry; a high projection does not by itself identify why the existing head gradient is misaligned.
